title: The functor and colimit of stage Hom sets
statement: For any preordered set I, diagram R:I→CommRing, i∈I, scheme Y with s:Y→Spec(R_i), and P,Q in its derived category [def-pc-derived-category], assuming all scheme derived categories exist, there are H:tail(≥i)→Type(max u w), a colimit cocone d and ident_j:H_j≃Hom(P_j,Q_j), where P_j,Q_j are the derived pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Under ident, H.map(j≤k) is exactly perfectStageMap [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. No directedness, finite presentation, perfectness or continuity is assumed. Colimits are in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Tag 09RE, filtered Hom system; Tag 0D5S, identity and composition coherence; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09RE checked 2026-10-13

proof.text: Transport along an identity is idempotent by perfectHomMap_trans. It is injective: baseChangeMap sends identities to identities, and the derived pullback of an identity is naturally isomorphic to the identity functor by exists_derivedPullbackComposition. Faithfulness therefore makes its map on Hom injective; conjugation by isomorphisms preserves this. An injective idempotent is the identity.

Define H_j as ULift of the stage Hom set and define its maps using perfectStageMap. The preceding argument gives map_id. For map_comp apply perfectHomMap_trans, then equality of the two Over arrows follows by extensionality, Spec.map_comp and R.map_comp. Define ident as Equiv.ulift.
Take the ordinary Type colimit cocone and colimit.isColimit. The transition equation is definitional. This constructs all data and needs no arbitrary witness of geometric existence.

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_hom_stage_colimit
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (i : I)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) :
    ∃ (H : Set.Ici i ⥤ Type (max u w)) (d : Cocone H),
      Nonempty (IsColimit d) ∧
      ∃ (ident : ∀ j : Set.Ici i, H.obj j ≃
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj P ⟶
           (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj Q)),
        (∀ (j k : Set.Ici i) (hjk : j ≤ k) (f : H.obj j),
          ident k (H.map (homOfLE hjk) f) =
            perfectStageMap R s j.property hjk (ident j f))
